description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act No. 9 of 2003, Special Direction under Section 10(1)(b)(11)
categorisation: This gazette content contains a special direction issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003, which establishes regulatory requirements for direct traders and network marketing companies. It creates legal obligations regarding registration, receipt issuance, advertising practices, and consumer rights protections. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments under existing legislation.
